title: Sleep of the Toddler and Night Wakings
summary: A toddler needs about 11–14 hours of sleep daily, including a nap. Night wakings and bedtime resistance are common. Establish a calm routine and regular timings, and avoid screens and stimulating activity before sleep. If severe wakings persist, or if snoring or breathing pauses occur, consult a doctor.
try_this: This week: Establish a short, calm sleep routine (bath, story, dim light) in the same order every night.
reflection_prompts: How are your child’s nights going?
